_comment: KB domain — ready-to-run deploy config. Provider/model + paths + connector source + the operator's allow_list. The domain definition (goal, metric, actions) lives in the domain_pack code. Edit provider keys via .env.
_backend_comment: HOW a model is reached. http = the providers below; claudeCode = the local Claude Code CLI on your own subscription (no api key). --fake-llm selects the offline backend.
_claudeCode_comment: Agent-CLI backend (backend: claudeCode): runs the analyze pass on your own Claude Code subscription instead of an api key, reaching this deploy's tools over MCP. bin empty = claude from PATH; model empty = the CLI default (e.g. opus | sonnet); timeout is seconds for the whole turn - it runs the entire tool loop. oneShotModel: the model for one-shot calls routed to the CLI (see one_shot); empty = model.
_one_shot_comment: WHERE one-shot calls go (an LLM-judged metric; analyze when analyze_tool_steps is 0) - routed apart from the agentic analyze pass, which goes to backend. A key of providers = that HTTP provider; claudeCode = the CLI on your subscription (--json-schema, ~6 s per call, no api key). Empty = provider when one is configured, else the backend itself - so a claudeCode deploy without any provider needs no api key at all.
_schedule_comment: run-loop (unattended): interval between ticks (90s / 15m / 1h); until = local HH:MM end, empty = run until Ctrl+C; passes_per_day / tokens_per_day = budget over a rolling 24 h counted from the log, 0 = no limit (a tick over budget is skipped); max_backoff = the longest wait after repeated failures. Command-line --interval / --until / --ticks override.
_notify_comment: run-loop only: a shell command run when the loop needs a human - a pass left actions held, after_failures passes failed in a row, or the daily budget ran out; each told once, not every tick. It gets NFM_EVENT (held | failing | budget), NFM_MESSAGE and NFM_DEPLOY as environment variables - read them as variables, never paste them into the command text (the message quotes model output). Empty = off. Windows popup: powershell -NoProfile -Command "msg $env:USERNAME $env:NFM_MESSAGE" · Linux: notify-send night-forge "$NFM_MESSAGE"
_analyze_tool_steps_comment: agentic analyze: max read_entry tool calls per run; 0 = one-shot
_git_comment: Git versioning of the materialized KB - REQUIRED here because edit_entry is allow-listed: edit_entry is honestly reversible=false (it overwrites curated content), so the gate only auto-runs it when git makes it revertible (enabled + granularity=per_action + repo healthy/clean). repo_dir is data/kb (the markdown only; already gitignored in the source tree so the artifact repo nests cleanly). PRE-INITIALIZE it: `git init` inside data/kb. Set remote (e.g. origin) to also push; empty = local-only. If git is unavailable/dirty, edit_entry safely HOLDS for approval instead.
